mapper.select: SELECT tmpa.*, tmpb.* FROM ( SELECT a.*, b.pub_date FROM stock_info a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CODE, max( DATE_FORMAT( pub_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) pub_date FROM stock_growth GROUP BY CODE ) b ON a.CODE = b.CODE WHERE a.type = 1 AND a.stock_status = 1 ) tmpa LEFT JOIN stock_growth tmpb ON tmpa.CODE = tmpb.CODE AND tmpa.pub_date = DATE_FORMAT( tmpb.pub_date, '%Y-%m-%d' )
